tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Domain Name System, the hierarchical and decentralized naming system used to identify computers reachable through the Internet."?
tech.correct: DNS

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Hypertext Transfer Protocol, the foundation of data communication for the World Wide Web."?
tech.correct: HTTP

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Application Programming Interface, a connection between computers or between computer programs."?
tech.correct: API

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "HyperText Markup Language, the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser."?
tech.correct: HTML

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Cascading Style Sheets, a style sheet language used for describing the presentation of a document written in a markup language."?
tech.correct: CSS

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "A programming language that is one of the core technologies of the World Wide Web, alongside HTML and CSS."?
tech.correct: JavaScript

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "An interpreted high-level general-purpose programming language."?
tech.correct: Python

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "A high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language."?
tech.correct: Java

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "A general-purpose programming language created by Bjarne Stroustrup as an extension of the C programming language."?
TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Structured Query Language, used in programming and designed for managing data held in a relational database management system."?
tech.correct: SQL

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "JavaScript Object Notation, an open standard file format and data interchange format."?
tech.correct: JSON

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Extensible Markup Language, a markup language that defines a set of rules for encoding documents in a format that is both human-readable and machine-readable."?
tech.correct: XML

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Distributed version control system for tracking changes in source code during software development."?
tech.correct: Git

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "A set of platform as a service products that use OS-level virtualization to deliver software in packages called containers."?
tech.correct: Docker

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "An open-source container-orchestration system for automating computer application deployment, scaling, and management."?
tech.correct: Kubernetes

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "The on-demand availability of computer system resources, especially data storage and computing power, without direct active management by the user."?
tech.correct: Cloud Computing

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "The study of computer algorithms that can improve automatically through experience and by the use of data."?
tech.correct: Machine Learning

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Intelligence demonstrated by machines, as opposed to natural intelligence displayed by animals including humans."?
tech.correct: Artificial Intelligence

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "Internet of Things, describes physical objects that are embedded with sensors, processing ability, software, and other technologies that connect and exchange data with other devices and systems over the Internet."?
tech.correct: IoT

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "The practice of protecting systems, networks, and programs from digital attacks."?
tech.correct: Cybersecurity

tech.q: TRIVIA: Which technology concept is defined as: "The process of encoding information so that only authorized parties can access it."?
tech.correct: Encryption
